elements_selected.content:
Comprehensive integration test covering the full SPEC-013 feature set. Create or use a test vault with: multiple pages with known content, known link structure, headings at various levels, exclusion zones (code blocks, frontmatter with searchable terms, HTML comments), and at least one isolated page.

Verify:
  1. zetl index builds both link graph and search index.
  2. zetl search returns BM25-scored results with heading context — relevance ranking correct.
  3. Exclusion zones: frontmatter/code/comments not indexed.
  4. --near restricts to neighbourhood correctly (bidirectional).
  5. --near composes with --path, --context, --case-sensitive, --limit.
  6. zetl serve /api/search returns same results as CLI (minus graph scoping).
  7. Serve mode Cmd+K shows full-text results with heading context.
  8. zetl build emits valid search-index.json.
  9. Build mode Cmd+K performs client-side BM25 search.
  10. Index invalidation: modify a file, re-index, verify search reflects changes.
  11. Lazy index: search without prior index works.
  12. All NFR targets met: index build ≤5s, query ≤100ms, BFS ≤50ms, API ≤50ms (for reasonable corpus sizes).
  13. cargo test passes.

All REQ-013-*, TEST-013-*, NFR-013-*.
Modified 5 files (+99, -344): .hence/context-manifest.json, src/cli.rs, src/main.rs, src/search.rs, tests/integration.rs
